exposure: Different decidual spiral artery collection methods
Tissue collection method (decidua basalis biopsy, fetal membrane roll biopsy, and decidual vacuum suction biopsy)
outcome: Association of AA with clinical parameters
finding: Placental bed vacuum suction provides a higher detection rate of spiral arteries and acute atherosis (AA) compared to conventional pathology samples, and the association of AA with pre-eclampsia related clinical parameters varies according to tissue collection method.
gest_age: Lower in pregnancies with AA detected in vacuum suctioned decidua basalis samples
birth_weight: Lower percentile in pregnancies with AA detected in vacuum suctioned decidua basalis samples
